messages:
Sam (Support): Escalating LanternAI import failures — large CSV imports returning 429/ingest_rate_exceeded for several pilot customers. Mid-pilot, renewal touch in 2 weeks. @Rina can you own? :warning:
Rina (CS): Ack. Need quick mitigation + comms. Is this quota or client bug?
Diego (Solutions): Likely rate cap plus large-batch retries missing. Sam, paste sample error + tenant id.
Sam (Support): Logs:
[2026-09-02T08:14:22Z] ingest batch=bf9c tenant=lantern-tenant-9 err=429 body="ingest_rate_exceeded"
Repro: uploads >500 rows fail consistently. Ticket 88211.
Rina (CS): Comms plan: 1) immediate ack + short workaround guidance 2) offer to run imports for them 3) request temporary quota bump 4) schedule 30m enablement to review importer best-practices. Owner=Eli; tech=Diego.
Eli (Account): I'll send comms now and offer assist.
Diego (Solutions): Opening infra request for +2x throughput for 3h; also prototyping client-side retry with exponential backoff (fast deploy).
infra-bot: Infra request submitted: INC-4422, pending approval.
Sam (Support): Infra approved +2x for pilot window, applied at 10:52. Monitoring shows retries now succeeding.
Eli (Account): Ran import with customer over screenshare at 11:00 — finished, success rate 99.6%. Customer requested clearer import guidance and a preflight check. Capturing feedback.
Rina (CS): Closing loop: immediate risk mitigated, renewal risk de-escalated. Follow-ups: add preflight checker to docs/UI (owner=Rina, ETA 4 days), merge retry patch (Diego), postmortem (Rina). Thanks team. :handshake:
